provenance.referenced_companion_json: canon-3d-visual-contract.json was named by the Markdown brief but not supplied or located for this implementation
provenance.equation_status: new explicit implementation of the supplied textual partition and kernel; not a recovered or canonical CANON equation
provenance.data: data/bundle.json is copied byte-for-byte from the accepted trace prototype; source tree, ledger, trace values, source identities and provenance remain authoritative
provenance.data_status: authored synthetic facts; previously simulated discrete queue events; derived visual partition; no measured empirical trace and no new simulation

partition.backup_only: B = (R minus (C union Q)) intersect set(record.identities.backups)
partition.absent: A = R minus (C union Q union B)
assertions: all four categories are pairwise disjoint
identity output order follows the native required-identity list
partition.not_raw_counts: Backup copies may persist after replay or completion; backup_only excludes ready and completed identities. No raw overlapping counts are added into the field.
partition.source_vs_view: Partitions are derived views; source arrays including non-required identities remain preserved in the raw record. Missing arrays and duplicate identities within each native array cause rejection rather than imputation.

plane.meaning: fixed category anchors, not measured distance, physical geometry or inferred topology

coordinates.height_unit: required identity count per artificial display area, multiplied only by the exported shared presentation gain
coordinates.time: selected ordered event is a playback/inspection parameter, not a now-body axis
coordinates.camera: orbit/pan/zoom/projection transform only the shared scene; no per-object data rotations or category permutations

kernel.meaning: explicit spatial rendering softness; not probability, fitted distribution, physical stress, temporal smoothing, learned geometry or uncertainty
kernel.exact_counts: Counts and attached identities stay visible at anchors. Summed field peaks are not category counts.
kernel.uncropped_mass: Analytically, integral over the whole plane equals sum_k n_k. Task outcomes never use field mass or peak height.
kernel.numerical_evaluation: AS 7.1.26 erf polynomial approximation with per-erf maximum absolute error 1.5e-7; reported rectangle-mass absolute error bound total_count*(3e-7+2.25e-14)
kernel.tail_disclosure: Finite crop omits Gaussian tails; clipped display volume is not exact required count. cropInfo records approximate inside and omitted mass.
kernel.normalization: No per-object, per-world or per-frame peak/total normalization. Shared explicit height gain is a presentation parameter.

temporal_inspection.ordering: Native time plus event_index; pre_action and post_action at time zero remain distinct selections.
temporal_inspection.prefix: Only records with event_index <= selected.event_index AND time_s <= selected.time_s AND known_at_s <= selected.time_s are eligible. Precomputed future segments and outcomes are not consulted.
temporal_inspection.history: Event ribs and held-state steps from retained discrete records, trailing-only by default. Same-time events may have coincident native-time coordinates and remain separately labeled/selectable; no fabricated elapsed delay.
temporal_inspection.interpolation: No temporal interpolation of category values, fractional-job animation, oscillation or spectral analysis.
temporal_inspection.native: No time shift; native source seconds.
temporal_inspection.decision: Native seconds minus the declared decision_origin anchor, available only from supplied scenario transform metadata.
temporal_inspection.first_service_boundary: Native seconds minus the first scheduled tick boundary; it is known at zero and is not a claim that service or completion occurred there.
temporal_inspection.first_completed_payload: Native seconds minus the first service_end record in the selected prefix with completed_this_tick nonempty; unavailable before any such record exists.
temporal_inspection.alignment: A and B retain independent anchor records/seconds and selected native times. Residual selected-time delay is reported. Alignment translates time only; no value scaling or time warping follows from choosing an anchor.

coupled_views.now: One selected event per world, shared category field and calibration for A/B.
coupled_views.transverse: A declared section of the same selected field; section coordinate and width/gain share the now-body contract. Not an independent generated dataset.
coupled_views.history: Category lanes, explicitly time-valued coordinate, native count height. History geometry is a different declared perspective from count-density now-body geometry.
coupled_views.native_evidence: Exact category membership, raw selected record and source refs are directly inspectable. Configured rate, offered service and original deadline are reported separately with native units.

comparison.selection: A and optional B independently select case/action/world/ordered record. Alternative worlds are never averaged or assigned probabilities.
comparison.failure: Refuse incompatible coordinate mappings instead of silently making them coincide.
comparison.styles: A surface and B contour/wireframe labels are presentation identity, not data magnitude or confidence. Color supplements letters and surface style.
comparison.interpretation: Coincidence means equality in this selected disposition view. Histories, identities, actions, constraints and source relations may differ. No causal similarity score or intervention claim.

information_not_geometrically_represente: Exact identity strings, FIFO order and backup relationships remain in record/source drill-down even when category cardinalities coincide.
Original deadlines, configured rates, service offered, costs and action provenance are separate native values, not added into the count-density field.
Sensor cases and unused source fields remain in the complete copied packet and ledger as preserved unaligned evidence; this queue geometry does not claim to encode them.
World uncertainty retains its native discrete status; visual softness and opacity do not express probability.
Source missingness, units, timestamps and provenance remain in the source envelope and mappings; unsupported quantities are not populated.
Lifecycle labels, L_P, physical load, spectral content and universal geometry are not supplied by this rendering.
view_manifest_requirements: selected A/B scenario/world/record IDs, event indices and native times
coordinate roles and fixed anchor positions
shared kernel width, value gain, crop bounds and computed tail masses
event anchors independently for A/B, shifts and residual delays
camera yaw/pitch/zoom/pan/projection and actual perspective/orthographic transform settings
surface/contour/exact layer choices and comparison mode
history span, transverse position, renderer grid resolution, culling/clipping rules and visual style parameters

acceptance.numeric: identity partitions, common calibration, prefix safety, separate worlds, source preservation and view export/restore
acceptance.browser: actual visible page, orbit, scrub, source retrieval, compare and export; non-browser tests do not establish usability
acceptance.human: User can locate the chosen now, perceive named changed contributions, distinguish missing from backup-only work, compare and inspect supporting evidence. This remains subject to user review.
